sections.title: Overview
sections.body: The Reporting module provides cross-cutting analytical views that span multiple projects, cost centers, and time periods. All roles can access this module. Reports are **role-scoped**: controllers and executives see all data, CC owners see their cost center, and project leads see their projects.

sections.title: Report Library
sections.body: The landing page shows all available reports as cards. **Standard Reports** are pre-built analytical views. **My Saved Views** shows any report configurations you have saved for quick access. Click any card to open the report.

sections.title: Standard Reports
sections.body: Five standard reports are available: **Programme / Multi-Project Rollup** for consolidated financials, **Cost Center Financial Summary** for per-CC analysis, **Vendor Spend Analysis** for external cost tracking, **Forecast Accuracy** for retrospective forecast quality, and **Year-over-Year Comparison** for spending trajectory analysis.

sections.title: Report Viewer
sections.body: Each report opens in a viewer with a **filter bar** at the top, a **KPI summary row** below it, and the main content area showing either a **chart** or **table** view. Use the toggle to switch between chart and table. Filters update all sections when changed.

sections.title: Customizing Reports
sections.body: Click the **Customize** button to open a configuration panel where you can show/hide columns, change the grouping dimension, adjust sort order, and select visualization type. These customizations apply immediately to the current view.

sections.title: Exporting Data
sections.body: Click **Export** to download the current report as an Excel file. The export respects all active filters and customizations. The file includes a data sheet with headers, rows, and a summary row, plus a metadata sheet noting the report name, export date, and active filters.

sections.title: Saving Views
sections.body: Click **Save View** to save your current filter and customization settings as a named view. Saved views appear in the Report Library under **My Saved Views** for quick access. You can rename or delete saved views from the library.

sections.title: AI Report Builder
sections.body: The **AI Report Builder** tile in the Report Library opens a conversational interface where you can describe any report in natural language. The AI queries the database directly, generates tables, charts, and KPI cards, and lets you iteratively refine the output. An Anthropic API key must be configured in **Administration > Planning Parameters > Integrations** before use.
